egress.terms: 'Download volume: Unlimited' for both Free and Registered rows. No egress meter at all; anonymous (unregistered) upload is 200 MB/file with 5-day retention.

record.tooling: XFileSharing Pro; API-key upload path at /api/upload/server?utype=anon (and /api/upload/server?key=<api key> from the account dashboard); web upload form posts to fs<nn>.uploadhive-style cgi-bin; PolyUploader covers the family
record.chaining: N free registrations, one per XFileSharing host, each ~0.2-2 TB: UpZur 1,953 GB + FileAxa 488 GB + Mega4up 183 GB + the rest of the family (see notes). A single identity source (free email) times a long commodity host list.
record.limits_note: 5,120 MB per file for registered; 120-day retention reset by download; unlimited download volume; no published upload/day cap
record.reliability_note: anonymous upload_form 302-redirects to login, so the 1.9 TB tier is registration-gated rather than anonymous; the anon API path returned Apache 500 on this host
